description: Grouped engines' copy of create-ticket: a Jira bug raised through ticket:raise-bug (assigned to me, in the active sprint, at To Do, at the project's bug priority); off-board as before

input-arguments.name: problem
input-arguments.description: The checked analysis of the problem: summary, root cause, where it is, evidence, what it blocks, whether it needs the operator
input-arguments.example: Dev container needs rebuilding: node 24 image changed

key.description: The key of the ticket created

no-ticket-reason.description: Why key is empty: the analysis did not hold, or ticket:create failed twice. "" when key is set

why.description: One line: what didn't hold, or the create command's error as it printed. "" when key is set
